##### `IsConstruct` <a name="IsConstruct" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.Dashboard.isConstruct"></a>

```csharp
using Io.Cdktn.Providers.Datadog;

Dashboard.IsConstruct(object X);
```

Checks if `x` is a construct.

Use this method instead of `instanceof` to properly detect `Construct`
instances, even when the construct library is symlinked.

Explanation: in JavaScript, multiple copies of the `constructs` library on
disk are seen as independent, completely different libraries. As a
consequence, the class `Construct` in each copy of the `constructs` library
is seen as a different class, and an instance of one class will not test as
`instanceof` the other class. `npm install` will not create installations
like this, but users may manually symlink construct libraries together or
use a monorepo tool: in those cases, multiple copies of the `constructs`
library can be accidentally installed, and `instanceof` will behave
unpredictably. It is safest to avoid using `instanceof`, and using
this type-testing method instead.

##### `GenerateConfigForImport` <a name="GenerateConfigForImport" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.Dashboard.generateConfigForImport"></a>

```csharp
using Io.Cdktn.Providers.Datadog;

Dashboard.GenerateConfigForImport(Construct Scope, string ImportToId, string ImportFromId, TerraformProvider Provider = null);
```

Generates CDKTN code for importing a Dashboard resource upon running "cdktn plan <stack-name>".

###### `Scope`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="Scope" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.Dashboard.generateConfigForImport.parameter.scope"></a>

- *Type:* Constructs.Construct

The scope in which to define this construct.

---

###### `ImportToId`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="ImportToId" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.Dashboard.generateConfigForImport.parameter.importToId"></a>

- *Type:* string

The construct id used in the generated config for the Dashboard to import.

---

###### `ImportFromId`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="ImportFromId" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.Dashboard.generateConfigForImport.parameter.importFromId"></a>

- *Type:* string

The id of the existing Dashboard that should be imported.

Refer to the {@link https://registry.terraform.io/providers/datadog/datadog/4.27.0/docs/resources/dashboard#import import section} in the documentation of this resource for the id to use

---

###### `Provider`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="Provider" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.Dashboard.generateConfigForImport.parameter.provider"></a>

- *Type:* Io.Cdktn.TerraformProvider

? Optional instance of the provider where the Dashboard to import is found.

### DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition <a name="DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition"></a>

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition.Initializer"></a>

```csharp
using Io.Cdktn.Providers.Datadog;

new DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition {
    string AlertId,
    string VizType,
    string Description = null,
    bool|IResolvable HideIncompleteCostData = null,
    string LiveSpan = null,
    DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinitionTime Time = null,
    string Title = null,
    string TitleAlign = null,
    string TitleSize = null
};
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.alertId">AlertId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The ID of the monitor used by the widget. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.vizType">VizType</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Whether to display the Alert Graph as a timeseries or a top list. Valid values are `timeseries`, `toplist`. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.description">Description</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The description of the widget. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.hideIncompleteCostData">HideIncompleteCostData</a></code> | <code>bool\|Io.Cdktn.IResolvable</code> | Hide any portion of the widget's timeframe that is incomplete due to cost data not being available. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.liveSpan">LiveSpan</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The timeframe to use when displaying the widget. |
| <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinition.property.time">Time</a></code> | <code><a href="#@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinitionTime">DashboardWidgetAlertGraphDefinitionTime</a></code> | time block. |

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |

##### `Value`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="Value" id="@cdktn/provider-datadog.dashboard.DashboardWidgetDistributionDefinitionMarker.property.value"></a>

```csharp
public string Value { get; set; }
```

- *Type:* string

Value to apply.

Can be a single value `y = 15` or a range of values `0 < y < 10`. For Distribution widgets with `display_type` set to `percentile`, this should be a numeric percentile value (for example, `90` for P90).

Docs at Terraform Registry: {@link https://registry.terraform.io/providers/datadog/datadog/4.27.0/docs/resources/dashboard#value Dashboard#value}
